The model follows detailed instructions closely and plans typography and layout together, so dense, multi-part visuals like infographics, posters, and title screens hold their structure and small text stays legible. Grok Imagine Image 2.0 Preview also supports image editing, keeping subjects and details consistent across repeated generations. Try the model out now in imagine.vercel.sh , running on AI Gate
